reuse.why: All month-wide actions route through the new shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate and averageBudgetAmount, and copyPreviousMonth reuses the existing getBudgetData query; the category-loading SQL however is not shared.

duplication.why: The categories+groups+group-notes SELECT is copy-pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three N-month-average actions instead of being one query helper.

placement.why: The predicate and amount helper live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them and the new method is registered in app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but the test diff renames unused locals in the copyUntilYearEnd setup (hiddenCategory, hiddenGroup) for no reason.

maintainability.why: The rule is in one predicate, but five near-identical SQL copies must all keep selecting group_hidden/group_notes/goal_def for the predicate to work, and 'averageBudgetAmount' is reused for a non-average.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No call site bypasses shouldWriteMonthBudget; every month-wide action calls it.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category SELECT in setZero/setLastMonthSpending/set3/6/12MonthAvg is an open copy (only whitespace differs), not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget gained the includeHiddenCategories parameter; the #fixed and goal_def exclusions are rule clauses, not special cases, and all callers use the predicate.
